explanation: Searched Mathlib (commit 83abb3e776bd) for `Subcoalgebra` and for structures with `mk'` (grep over the whole Mathlib tree): Mathlib has no `Subcoalgebra` type or `Subcoalgebra`/`mk'` construction at all; the `mem_mk'` lemmas there concern `Subring`, `Subsemiring`, `NonUnitalSubring`, `TwoSidedIdeal`, `Subalgebra.Ordering` and `AffineSubspace` — all different notions. This theorem is a trivial `Iff.rfl` restatement of the membership of the library's own `Subcoalgebra.mk'` definition (it is the `Subcoalgebra` analogue of the library's `mem_mk`, and holds by definitional reduction to `SetLike.mem_coe`/`Submodule.mem` for the locally defined structure). Its mathematical content lies entirely in the library's own definition, so it is not a duplicate, nor a special case, of any Mathlib declaration.
